const label = "outer";
function describe(name = label) {
  const label = "inner";
  return `${name}/${label}`;
}
console.log(describe());

type Unit = "cm";
function measure(value: number, unit: Unit = "cm") {
  type Unit = number;
  const scale: Unit = 2;
  return `${value * scale}${unit}`;
}
console.log(measure(3));

function counter(start = 0, step = start + 1) {
  var start: number;
  return [start, step];
}
console.log(counter(), counter(5));

class Box<T> {
  constructor(private item: T, private fallback: T = item) {}
  get(): T[] {
    return [this.item, this.fallback];
  }
}
console.log(new Box(4).get());

const values = [1, 2, 3].map((x, index) => {
  var x = x * 10;
  return x + index;
});
console.log(values);
